entropyFinding.__note: 🔴 READ THIS BEFORE PICKING AN ENTROPY THRESHOLD. Every figure here is MEASURED over the shipped bytes and asserted by check V8 — none is assumed.
entropyFinding.headline: NO Shannon-entropy threshold separates the positives from the negatives in this corpus. Entropy is not a standalone heuristic. It is a weak tiebreak for long, unprefixed, unstructured values, and it must never gate a prefix or shape match.
entropyFinding.theProof: A threshold must be <= 4.7719 to catch POS-aws-secret-access-key, and > 5.0225 to clear NEG-base64-icon. No such number exists. The only window that clears every negative is (5.0225, 5.1952] — 0.17 bits wide, positioned by a single 542-char data URI — and even inside it POS-aws-secret-access-key is missed. Lowering the threshold to 4.5 (an earlier draft of this file proposed exactly that) flags NEG-base64-icon at 5.02 AND NEG-windows-install-path at 4.52, and the latter is a REDACTED INSTALL PATH copied from the real fixtures, present on every plugin record in both the CLI and file layers.
entropyFinding.whyLengthGatingDoesNotRescueIt: Both offending negatives are long: the data URI is 542 chars and the install path is 70. A `length >= 32` precondition admits both. Length filters out short benign tokens; it does nothing about long structured ones.
entropyFinding.hexIsAnArtefact: Hex alphabets cap at 4.0 bits/char (16 symbols), so every 40-hex value — git SHA, .gcs-sha, source.sha — is STRUCTURALLY incapable of exceeding 4.0. Any threshold above 4.0 spares them automatically. That is a property of the alphabet, not evidence that the threshold is well chosen, and it does not extend to base64 digests, which reach ~5.9.
entropyFinding.whatActuallySeparates: Structure, not magnitude. NEG-base64-icon is identified by its `data:` scheme; NEG-windows-install-path by its separators and drive prefix; NEG-session-uuid by its 8-4-4-4-12 grouping; the SHAs by being pure hex of a fixed length. Recognise and exclude those forms FIRST, then apply entropy to what remains.
entropyFinding.recomputeWith: node fixtures/synthetic/generate.mjs verify — check V8 asserts that highestNegative, lowestPositive, lowestEntropyOnlyPositive and highestEntropyOnlyPositive above still equal the measured extremes, so these claims cannot drift from the data.
